Okay, let's get a couple of things straight.

Firstly, regulation is a must. Regardless of your stance on whether or not vaping carries health risks, the manufacture of the e-cigarettes, as well as the nicotine cartridges, must be regulated, to ensure shoddy business practises don't creep in.

Secondly, anyone claiming that it is not a smoking cession tool is missing the point.

People don't smoke because they love the sensation of breathing tar and all kinds of other crap into their lungs. They smoke because they have become addicted to the nicotine.

Vaping allows people to continue that habit, sans the tar and god knows what else was in those white paper death sticks. It was never designed to be a cession tool; it is just another way to get a nicotine fix.

There is no second-hand smoke, so you aren't killing those around you at the same time.

Yes, vaping is not 100% safe, but it is a darn sight safer than what came before, and we should stop entertaining the idea that it is just as bad as regular smoking, because to be frank, that is complete bullshit.
